Where is the sheep?

Tap the grass. One sheep is hidden. The Good Shepherd never loses count of His sheep—and He is glad when the lost one is found.

Tap a square—find the sheep!

KJV (Luke 15:4–6 idea): What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine… and go after that which is lost, until he find it? And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
